title: zstd-at-rest contract (L18)
description: Compression policy for older MAGMA events. See ADR-030.

invariants.name: age_threshold
invariants.description: Events younger than cold_threshold_days=7 stored UNCOMPRESSED. Older go through compression pipeline.
must: cold_threshold_days default = 7 (configurable)
age computed at compression-decision time as (now - event.produced_at_utc).days
threshold check happens at batch close OR snapshot rotation

invariants.name: zstd_level_default_3
invariants.description: zstd_level=3 default (fast/medium balance). Per-profile override allowed in range 1-22.
must: default 3
profile override accepts range 1..22
out-of-range value rejected by validator

invariants.name: batch_level_granularity
invariants.description: Compression applied per ADR-028 Merkle batch (1024 events), not per-event. Maximizes shared dictionary.
must: compression unit = 1 Merkle batch (1024 events)
per-event compression is explicitly forbidden (loses dictionary sharing)
batch boundary matches ADR-028 batch_size

invariants.name: hash_domain_unchanged
invariants.description: sha256 hashes computed on UNCOMPRESSED event canonical bytes. Compression is storage-only.
must: leaf hash = sha256(uncompressed_event_canonical_bytes)
Merkle interior hashes computed on uncompressed leaves per ADR-028
compression NEVER affects hash inputs

invariants.name: decompress_on_read
invariants.description: Reads of compressed batches decompress lazily. Warm-promotion (ADR-029) caches decompressed form.
must: read path: fetch compressed bytes -> decompress -> verify hash -> return
decompressed value is the value populated into ADR-029 warm cache
raw compressed bytes do NOT leak above the storage layer

invariants.name: decompression_fails_closed
invariants.description: Decompression failure -> ERROR log + raw replay fallback per ADR-021. No data returned that has not been hash-verified.
must: zstd.ZstdError -> ERROR log with batch_index + event_index + raise
fall back to raw replay path (ADR-021 fallback_contract)
no partial decompression result returned to caller

invariants.name: disable_per_profile
invariants.description: Operator can set zstd_at_rest_enabled=false per profile to skip compression entirely.
must: default enabled=true
profile config respected at compression-decision time
disabled profile stores all events uncompressed regardless of age

out_of_scope: Migration tooling for existing uncompressed batches (separate PR)
zstd dictionary training (future ADR if benefit measured)
